_meta.note: Real DSH bridge at source commit 1206d4da80c779515618918f458c1ec32722f12d, driven through its compiled CLI in an isolated home against a loopback chat-completions endpoint. The published adapter does not advertise steering; this retained feature build does. Steer sent while first model stream was parked; queued and consumed echoes, second model request contained the steer, original prompt ended normally. Session id and scratch path normalized. No tools or paid model used. Raw captured frames reprocessed through capture_acp_compaction.reduce_frames: 1 configOptions select(s) cut to the one option naming its currentValue: the full list is the provider and model catalog the recording host could reach; the session id is replaced with the synthetic deepseek-session-1; message id(s) replaced with synthetic msg-N values.
